q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: WITH LowestBeerPrices AS (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) SELECT lbp.beer, COALESCE(lbp.min_price, -1) AS price, COALESCE(s.bar, 'None') AS bar FROM LowestBeerPrices AS lbp LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON lbp.beer = s.beer ORDER BY lbp.beer
